audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Ezekiel/Isaiah throne imagery; draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for open door, throne, living creatures, holy hymn, creator worship.

verses.restored: After these things I saw, and look, a door opened in heaven, and the first voice I heard like trumpet speaking with me said: Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.

familiar.text: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

modern.text: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”

original.text: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα ἠνεῳγμένη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἡ πρώτη ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς σάλπιγγος λαλούσης μετʼ ἐμοῦ, λέγων· Ἀνάβα ὧδε, καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι. μετὰ ταῦτα

verses.restored: Immediately I came to be in Spirit, and look, a throne stood in heaven, and upon the throne One sitting.

familiar.text: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

modern.text: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.

original.text: ⸀εὐθέως ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι· καὶ ἰδοὺ θρόνος ἔκειτο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον καθήμενος,

verses.restored: And the One sitting was like jasper stone and carnelian in appearance, and a rainbow around the throne like emerald in appearance.

familiar.text: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

modern.text: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.

original.text: ⸂καὶ ὁ καθήμενος⸃ ὅμοιος ὁράσει λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι καὶ σαρδίῳ, καὶ ἶρις κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ⸂ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ⸃.

verses.restored: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and upon the thrones twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, with golden crowns upon their heads.

familiar.text: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

modern.text: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads. Worship of the Creator

original.text: καὶ κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ⸀θρόνοι εἴκοσι τέσσαρες, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ⸀θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας πρεσβυτέρους καθημένους περιβεβλημένους ⸀ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν στεφάνους χρυσοῦς.

verses.restored: From the throne come flashes, voices, and thunders; and seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of the Divine.

familiar.text: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

modern.text: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven Spirits of God.

original.text: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου ἐκπορεύονται ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί· καὶ ἑπτὰ λαμπάδες πυρὸς καιόμεναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, ⸀ἅ εἰσιν ⸀τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ,

verses.restored: Before the throne, as sea of glass like crystal; and in midst of throne and around throne, four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

familiar.text: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

modern.text: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.

original.text: καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ὡς θάλασσα ὑαλίνη ὁμοία κρυστάλλῳ. Καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου τέσσαρα ζῷα γέμοντα ὀφθαλμῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν·

verses.restored: The first living creature like lion, the second like calf/young ox, the third having face like human, the fourth like flying eagle.

familiar.text: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

modern.text: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.

original.text: καὶ τὸ ζῷον τὸ πρῶτον ὅμοιον λέοντι, καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ζῷον ὅμοιον μόσχῳ, καὶ τὸ τρίτον ζῷον ⸀ἔχων ⸂τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς⸃ ἀνθρώπου, καὶ τὸ τέταρτον ζῷον ὅμοιον ἀετῷ πετομένῳ·

verses.restored: And the four living creatures, each having six wings, are full of eyes around and within, and they have no rest day and night saying: Holy, holy, holy, Lord Divine Almighty, the One who was and who is and who is coming.

familiar.text: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, LORD God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

modern.text: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”

original.text: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα, ἓν ⸂καθʼ ἓν⸃ ⸀αὐτῶν ⸀ἔχων ἀνὰ πτέρυγας ἕξ, κυκλόθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν γέμουσιν ὀφθαλμῶν· καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς λέγοντες· Ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος.

verses.restored: And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanks to the One sitting upon throne, the One living into the ages of ages,

familiar.text: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

modern.text: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,

original.text: καὶ ὅταν ⸀δώσουσιν τὰ ζῷα δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ εὐχαριστίαν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ ⸂τῷ θρόνῳ⸃, τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων,

verses.restored: the twenty-four elders fall before the One sitting upon throne and worship the One living into the ages of ages, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying:

familiar.text: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

modern.text: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:

original.text: πεσοῦνται οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἐνώπιον τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου, καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, καὶ βαλοῦσιν τοὺς στεφάνους αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, λέγοντες·

verses.restored: Worthy are you, our Lord and Divine, to receive glory and honor and power, because you created all things, and through your will they were and were created.

familiar.text: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

modern.text: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and came to be.”

original.text: Ἄξιος εἶ, ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ θεὸς ⸀ἡμῶν, λαβεῖν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν, ὅτι σὺ ἔκτισας ⸀τὰ πάντα, καὶ διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.

translation_notes: Throne imagery draws from Ezekiel and Isaiah; symbols should remain symbolic.
Creation worship centers Divine worth before later judgment scenes.
Seven Spirits is apocalyptic fullness of Spirit language.
safety_note: Revelation 4 anchors the book in worship of Creator, not fear or spectacle.
